queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Bambu Studio' AND publisher = 'Bambulab';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Bambu Studio' AND publisher = 'Bambulab' AND version_compare(version, '02.09.02.62') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'bambu-studio.exe');
